test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 6: COURSE LIFECYCLE (COURSE DELETION) - Phase 1: Preparation
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'NewSecurePass123!' is logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page.
test_cases.expected_result: A new course named 'Temporary Course for Deletion' is created and the Teacher is redirected to the course dashboard, where the new course is visible in the list. The system displays a success message confirming the course creation.
test_cases.post_condition: A new course named 'Temporary Course for Deletion' exists in the system and the Teacher is on the Course Details Page for this course.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Add New Course' button to open the 'New Course' modal.
Enter 'Temporary Course for Deletion' into the 'Course Name' field.
Upload 'temp_course_image.jpg' into the 'Course Image' file input field.
Click the 'Send' button to create the new course.
